before.overview: A long, sustained mixed free/bolted line up the steep southeast face of SEWS, starting about 100 yards right of The Passenger. Established over three visits between July and September 2007 by Bryan Burdo and Scott Johnston.

days.note: The easiest and most popular route on SEWS — mostly 3rd/4th class scrambling with a couple of 5.5-5.6 moves over 2 pitches. Often used as the descent route for the harder south-face lines as well.
days.title: Car-to-car climb

schedule.label: Begin descent
schedule.detail: Downclimb the arete, then 3 rappels from bolted stations to the base.

days.objective: Climb the South Arete and return to the Blue Lake trailhead

itinerary.totalNote: A short, classic beginner day: about 6 hrs car-to-car with only 2 pitches of easy 5th class.
